title: Florida man pulled over on lawn mower busted for meth and weed
comment: A deputy pulled over a red riding lawn mower on a public road because it was not, in any legal sense, a vehicle. The bag between the driver's feet turned out to hold meth, pills, and weed.
excerpt: Florida man pulled over on lawn mower busted for meth and weed FOX 13 Tampa Bay

title: Resort island POA fined SC man after he railed against them online. Now he's suing.
comment: A resort island property owners association fined a man for the things he wrote about them online. He is now suing, which is unlikely to improve his standing with the board.
excerpt: Resort island POA fined SC man after he railed against them online. Now he's suing. Post and Courier

title: St. Clair Shores man fined $15K for docking boats, attorney calls ordinance unconstitutional
comment: A Michigan man was fined $15,000 for docking boats at his own property. His attorney's characterization of the penalty is not printable in a family publication.
excerpt: St. Clair Shores man fined $15K for docking boats, attorney calls ordinance unconstitutional ClickOnDetroit | WDIV Local 4

title: Junction City parking update ends move-a-few-inches loophole
comment: For years, drivers beat the time limit by rolling forward a few inches to reset the clock. The city has now written an ordinance specifically to end the shuffle.
excerpt: Junction City parking update ends move-a-few-inches loophole The Register-Guard

title: Watch: Florida man breaks own record with mini basketball shot from 102 feet
comment: A Tampa man sank a miniature basketball from 102 feet — longer than a full court — to break the world record he already held. He trained for this at Pop-a-Shot.
excerpt: A Florida man launched a miniature basketball into a hoop from a distance of over 100 feet to break his own Guinness World Record.

title: Wanted Florida man caught hiding under mattress yells for mom who tried to punch officer: WHPD
comment: Officers spotted a suspiciously large lump in the middle of a mattress and lifted it to find their wanted man underneath. He immediately started yelling for his mother, who came running and made the situation considerably worse.
excerpt: Wanted Florida man caught hiding under mattress yells for mom who tried to punch officer: WHPD FOX 13 Tampa Bay

title: Watch: Texas police apprehend lemur on the loose
comment: Belton officers were dispatched to a lemur at large and described the suspect as fast, furry, and refusing to cooperate. He was detained and returned to his owner, because Texas lets you keep one of these.
excerpt: Police in Texas were called to wrangle an unusual pet described as "fast, furry and refusing to cooperate" -- a lemur.

title: Watch: Dog who spent 72 days lost in mountains wins Hambone Award
comment: A golden retriever bolted on Christmas Day near Lake Tahoe and spent 72 days in the mountains before a shelter scanned his microchip. Thin but unhurt, he came home and then won a national award for it.
excerpt: This year s Hambone Award, presented for unusual pet insurance claims, was given to a golden retriever who spent 72 days lost in the mountains.

title: Watch: Coyote chases bear away from Los Angeles home
comment: A bear wandered up to a Los Angeles home and was promptly run off by a coyote roughly a fifth its size. The footage settles nothing about the food chain.
excerpt: A Los Angeles man s home security camera captured an unusual confrontation between a bear and a mother coyote.

title: Disabled Navy Veteran Sues Her Homeowners Association Over Fees, Debt Collection
comment: A disabled Navy veteran says her HOA's charges kept appearing and vanishing while she sat locked out of the resident portal for ten months. She sold the condo and is now suing; the association denies everything.
excerpt: Disabled Navy Veteran Sues Her Homeowners Association Over Fees, Debt Collection Military.com
